# OnThisAyer — Complete Context & Documentation

## Overview
OnThisAyer is the public marketing and memory discovery platform for **Ayer App**, built by **Chapiware Studio**.
The project brings historical context to personal nostalgia: while OnThisAyer showcases what the world experienced on any given day, Ayer App empowers users to discover what *they* were doing in their own personal lives on that exact same day.

## Ayer App (by Chapiware)
- **Official URL:** https://www.chapiware.com/ayer/
- **Platform Availability:**
  - iOS (iPhone / iPad): Available on Apple App Store
  - Android: Available on Google Play Store
- **Tagline:** Your private photo memories, rediscovered every day.
- **Key Advantages:**
  1. **Zero Cloud / 100% Private:** Photos never leave the user's physical device. No account creation, no external servers, no AI data harvesting.
  2. **Offline First:** Operates seamlessly in airplane mode or without internet connectivity.
  3. **Seamless Calendar Sync:** Automatically groups photos and videos by calendar month and day across all past years.
  4. **Lightweight & Fast:** Minimal battery consumption, instant photo indexing, smooth modern iOS & Android UI.

## OnThisAyer Web Architecture
- **Web App URL:** https://xatpy.github.io/OnThisAyer/
- **Hosting:** GitHub Pages (Static hosting, 0 servers, 100% uptime, zero cost).
- **Data Pipeline:**
  - Consumes the public Wikimedia REST API (`https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/feed/onthisday/events/{month}/{day}`).
  - Validates historical records and selects high-impact moments with images.
  - Generates social media copy (Twitter/X and Instagram) formatted with years elapsed and Ayer download call-to-actions.
- **Privacy Guarantee:** The web interface collects no personal data, uses no tracking cookies, and runs purely client-side in modern web browsers.

## Contact & Credits
